$description: The sokkel-design contract: its version, which moves in lockstep with sokkel-ui before 1.0, the foundations every part refers to, and every part and pattern with its status. A stable part is a part as it landed in sokkel-ui, specified in the same round, or one drawn from its spec and compared side by side; a draft one may still change shape. How far each renderer has built a part is its own field, `renderers`, in the part's file. CHANGELOG.md says what each version changed.

renderers.reads: tokens.json, which it defines, and a pinned copy of the specs (design/)

renderers.alsoNamed: sokkel-ui-egui, in sources, rendererSpecific and drift

renderers.reads: tokens/tokens.resolved.json (paints with their flat and faded forms), the specs with their cells, and glyphs.json

tokens.source: sokkel-ui: packages/core/tokens/tokens.json, at the commit sokkel-ui.json pins

units: Lengths in px: 1rem = 16px = 1 egui point at scale 1.

md.means: Below it a window is a phone or a foldable: finger-sized targets, the rail as a drawer, dialogs as full-screen sheets.

lg.means: From it the shell's side panel is a column; below it the panel is a sheet.

cells.$description: The cell grid, for a renderer drawn in a terminal: a column stands for about pxPerColumn px at a 14 px glyph, and a row holds one line of text. Each part's own `cells` says its rows, padding and width.

md.means: Below it the frame is drawn as a phone draws it: the rail as a drawer, dialogs filling the screen. An 80 by 24 terminal is below it.

lg.means: From it the shell's side panel is a column.

checkSizes.means: a tmux split, or a phone over SSH
from lg: the panel a column

rules: A horizontal px length is round(px / pxPerColumn) columns, and at least 1 where it is not 0.
A vertical length is never divided: a control, a row of a table or a list, a bar and a head is one row whatever its px height. Room between is whole blank rows.
Room between stacked pieces is whole blank rows: under 12 px none; from 12 px one blank row at regular and none at compact, unless the part's cells say otherwise.
Density changes blank rows and side padding, never a row's height; a part's cells say what compact drops.
The radius ladder is one bit: a corner role above 0 draws rounded box corners, 0 square (glyphs.json, box).
No shadows or elevations: a popup or a dialog is its edge, drawn with the box glyphs.
Text is one size; a role keeps what textRoles gives it.

textRoles.$description: What a cell shows of each text role: bold or not, italic or not, and its ink. Size, line height and tracking are not drawn. No role carries an ink of its own (sokkel-ui sets none): the piece's paint gives it. `head` takes the theme's table-head-transform (uppercase in some themes).

colorDepth.$description: How a renderer that cannot draw every color (a terminal) draws the resolved ones, by the depth the terminal shows.
colorDepth.truecolor: The resolved colors. A renderer that cannot blend reads each paint's flat form (paints, flat), and a faded state's (paints, faded); colors outside the paints are opaque tokens already.
colorDepth.ansi256: Each opaque color is drawn as the nearest of xterm's indices 16 to 255, by distance in OKLab, the lower index on a tie: the cube (16 + 36r + 6g + b, each channel 0, 95, 135, 175, 215 or 255) and the grays (232 to 255, 8 + 10i). Never 0 to 15, whose colors the terminal's own theme sets.

ansi16.means: The colors the sixteen indices stand for in a sokkel terminal: the ansi-* tokens, which TerminalView gives xterm, resolved per theme and scheme. How a part's paints map onto these sixteen is open (open-questions.md, T1).

colorDepth.none: NO_COLOR set: no color at all, only bold, reverse and underline. Every state is carried by its words and its glyphs (glyphs.json): a state's word beside its dot, the sort arrows, the check, the issue mark (principle 22).
